description: Header file defining structures and function prototypes for 3GPP security algorithms, including initialization, deinitialization, keystream generation, and MAC computation for the SNOW 3G cipher.

methods.name: s3g_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SNOW 3G cipher state with a 128-bit key and IV.

methods.name: s3g_generate_keystream
methods.description: Generates a keystream of specified length in 32-bit words.

methods.name: s3g_f9
methods.description: Computes a 32-bit MAC using the UIA2 algorithm.
